domain: Keeper, operations, management, recovery and observability

prompt_review.sequential_critique_1: Replace generic always-safe/exhaustive/no-unknown language with exact profile, workflows, invariant boundaries, concrete failure sequences and honest source/execution/qualification distinctions. The system has no integrated bridge, creator inbox or timelock, and no new operator committee.
prompt_review.sequential_critique_2: Treat the already implemented coordination/reset/harvest behavior as baseline. Challenge source evidence and stored versus actual chain status; do not rerun unchanged suites or erase state to produce green checks. Management coverage must include old-key fencing, incomplete exits, post-exit royalties and whole-collection pre-exit recovery, not only rebalance.
prompt_review.result: Root twice-reviewed final prompt covers the reviewed operating model and boundaries. No extra policy questions block the demonstrated bug fixes.

architecture.authority: The user is one operator/governance controller. The automatic keeper has a limited distinct capability/key, not governance power. Contracts remain authoritative for ownership/custody/fees; the journal is authoritative for this signer recovery/spending, not NFT paid flags.
architecture.serial_path: One process lock and one saved pending nonce lane. Recover known/hashless intent and canonical checkpoint before lifecycle, confirmation deadline priority, optional queue and maintenance. Never auto-resend or adopt manual same-key work from LP/timer changes.
jobs: royalty conversion and deferred cohort sync
clocks: hard initial12h replacement interval; operator width exception still waits
accounting4 standalone hourly harvest clock also coalesces only exact own canonical FeesCollected proof
existing per-action paid-revert cooldown; principal Ready batch retry interval; separate optional job turns
canonical inclusion-day gas spend and captured original fee review; wall time versus block time versus monotonic watchdog have distinct roles
normal_model: activation/growth checkpoints incumbents and deploys entrant funds only, never resets replacement clock
compound service waits for authenticated in-range/no-pending-width even before rebalance cooldown
replacement spends the whole attributed bucket under on-chain eligibility and financial guards
current owner inherits remaining unclaimed rights; terminal principal and NFT earnings stay separate
recovery_model: configured matching release/profile and intact journal required; stale backup needs actual chain reconciliation
hashless pending blocks all new work and needs independently verified candidate identity
fault/reset markers and clear acknowledgements are durable; no repeated paid clear for a known cleared episode
local flock is not old-host fencing; compromised/lost service key needs governance revocation/rotation
canonical locked source stops new submissions; terminal exit never reopens principal; royalties/old rewards continue under their own controls
watchdog only main progress; real loaded Linux systemd/cgroup/backup/alert verification remains separate

invariants: No action bypasses a saved pending intent or consumes an unreviewed nonce.
Signed/recovered transaction identity and original gas/L1 allowance bind canonical actual spend exactly once.
No read-only report/snapshot/preflight submits or repairs a journal.
Unrelated optional faults cannot waive price/execution guards or fabricate values.
A relevant LP identity fault cannot reuse saved sampled evidence/jitter after recovery.
A current health success cannot be manufactured from a canonical anchor whose final depth/freshness/chronology no longer qualifies.
No scheduling cursor or successful deferred batch marks a holder principal paid; on-chain paid flags remain authoritative.
No reserve, dust, principal or pending external receipt is swept to operating expenses.
